BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and tokens. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional: leave empty to turn push notifications off.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional: leave empty to turn push notifications off.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Optional: a `mailto:` or `https:` contact for push services.

EMAIL_PROVIDER.description: Optional: cloudflare | resend | smtp. Empty picks the first configured provider.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional: the From address of transactional email. Required by every provider.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.

SMTP_HOST.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.

SMTP_PORT.description: Optional: the SMTP port. Defaults to 465.

SMTP_USER.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: Optional: leave empty to turn email off.
